description: This file defines a custom lint detector class 'DesignSystemDetector' that checks for incorrect usage of Compose Material API calls in Kotlin code, recommending the use of specific 'Now in Android' design system components instead.

classes.name: DesignSystemDetector
classes.description: A custom lint detector that flags the use of Compose Material APIs in favor of the project's design system components.

methods.name: getApplicableUastTypes
methods.description: Specifies the UAST node types this detector is interested in: call expressions and qualified reference expressions.

methods.name: createUastHandler
methods.description: Creates a handler object that processes UAST nodes to find incorrect API calls.

methods.name: visitCallExpression
methods.description: Handles call expressions in the code, checking if method names match known Material APIs.

methods.name: visitQualifiedReferenceExpression
methods.description: Handles qualified reference expressions, verifying receiver names against expected design system identifiers.

methods.name: reportIssue
methods.description: Reports an issue when a non-preferred API usage is detected.
